# Attesto v0.13.0 - Table of Contents

> Vendor-neutral OAuth2/OIDC engine for Elixir with DPoP, mTLS, and PKCE sender-constraint support.

## Pages

- [Attesto](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Changelog
  - [Changelog](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- License
  - [LICENSE](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Attesto](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.md): A vendor-neutral OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization-server and
resource-server engine.
- [Attesto.AuthorizationRequest](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.AuthorizationRequest.md): Authorization endpoint request validation (RFC 6749 §4.1.1, OIDC Core
§3.1.2.1, RFC 7636 §4.3).
- [Attesto.ClientAssertion](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.ClientAssertion.md): `private_key_jwt` client authentication verification (RFC 7523 / OIDC Core).
- [Attesto.ClientIdMetadata](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.ClientIdMetadata.md): Client ID Metadata Documents - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [Attesto.DeviceCode](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DeviceCode.md): RFC 8628 Device Authorization Grant — the conn-free core.
- [Attesto.DeviceCode.Grant](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DeviceCode.Grant.md): The validated context a successfully redeemed device code yields
(RFC 8628 §3.4).
- [Attesto.DeviceCodeStore](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DeviceCodeStore.md): Storage seam for the RFC 8628 device authorization grant.
- [Attesto.DeviceCodeStore.ETS](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DeviceCodeStore.ETS.md): Single-node ETS implementation of `Attesto.DeviceCodeStore`.
- [Attesto.EndSession](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.EndSession.md): Validate an OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout request
(OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout 1.0 §2-3).
- [Attesto.Introspection](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Introspection.md): OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection (RFC 7662), conn-free core.
- [Attesto.JARM](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.JARM.md): JWT Secured Authorization Response Mode (JARM).
- [Attesto.LogoutSessionStore](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.LogoutSessionStore.md): Storage seam for OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout 1.0.
- [Attesto.LogoutToken](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.LogoutToken.md): Mint OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout `logout_token`s
(OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout 1.0 §2.4).
- [Attesto.OpenIDDiscovery](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.OpenIDDiscovery.md): OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 - OpenID Provider Metadata (§3).
- [Attesto.ProtectedResourceMetadata](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.ProtectedResourceMetadata.md): RFC 9728 - OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata.
- [Attesto.RequestObject](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.RequestObject.md): Signed OpenID Connect Request Object verification (JAR, RFC 9101 / OIDC §6.1).
- [Attesto.RequestObject.Policy](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.RequestObject.Policy.md): Verification policy for signed authorization request objects (JAR, RFC 9101).
- [Attesto.ResourceIndicator](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.ResourceIndicator.md): RFC 8707 Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0 — the conn-free primitive.
- [Attesto.SignedIntrospection](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.SignedIntrospection.md): JWT response for OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection (RFC 9701).
- [Attesto.SigningAlg](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.SigningAlg.md): Key-derived JOSE signing algorithm helpers.
- [Attesto.StepUp](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.StepUp.md): RFC 9470 Step-Up Authentication Challenge — the conn-free core primitive.
- [Attesto.StepUp.Requirement](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.StepUp.Requirement.md): A normalized RFC 9470 step-up authentication requirement for a protected route.

- Core
  - [Attesto.Config](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Config.md): Immutable configuration a token operation runs against.
  - [Attesto.IDToken](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.IDToken.md): Mint and verify OpenID Connect ID Tokens (OpenID Connect Core 1.0 §2).
  - [Attesto.PrincipalKind](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.PrincipalKind.md): One kind of subject a token can describe.
  - [Attesto.Token](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Token.md): Mint and verify RS256 JWT access tokens.

- Grants
  - [Attesto.AuthorizationCode](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.AuthorizationCode.md): RFC 6749 §4.1 authorization-code grant, with mandatory PKCE (RFC 7636,
S256) and optional DPoP binding of the code (RFC 9449 §10).
  - [Attesto.AuthorizationCode.Grant](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.AuthorizationCode.Grant.md): The validated context a successfully redeemed authorization code yields.
  - [Attesto.IdentityAssertion](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.IdentityAssertion.md): Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG) verification - the resource
Authorization Server's half of the Identity Assertion Authorization Grant
(`draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant-04`), the grant behind MCP
Enterprise-Managed Authorization (EMA).
  - [Attesto.PKCE](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.PKCE.md): RFC 7636 - Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE).
  - [Attesto.RefreshToken](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.RefreshToken.md): Refresh-token issuance and rotation with reuse detection
(RFC 6749 §6 / §10.4, OAuth 2.0 Security BCP).
  - [Attesto.Revocation](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Revocation.md): RFC 7009 - OAuth 2.0 Token Revocation, for refresh tokens.

- Plugs
  - [Attesto.Plug.Authenticate](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Plug.Authenticate.md): Authenticate a protected-resource request: verify the access token and,
for a DPoP-bound or mTLS-bound token, the sender-constraint proof.
  - [Attesto.Plug.OAuthError](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Plug.OAuthError.md): Render the RFC 6750 / RFC 9449 error responses for the Attesto plugs.
  - [Attesto.Plug.RequireScopes](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Plug.RequireScopes.md): Authorize a request against the scopes on the verified token.

- Stores
  - [Attesto.CodeStore](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.CodeStore.md): Storage seam for authorization codes.
  - [Attesto.CodeStore.ETS](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.CodeStore.ETS.md): Single-node ETS implementation of `Attesto.CodeStore`.
  - [Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore.md): Storage seam for server-issued DPoP nonces (RFC 9449 §8).
  - [Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore.ETS](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore.ETS.md): Single-node ETS implementation of `Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore`.
  - [Attesto.RefreshStore](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.RefreshStore.md): Storage seam for refresh tokens, with the atomic primitive that makes
reuse detection possible.
  - [Attesto.RefreshStore.ETS](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.RefreshStore.ETS.md): Single-node ETS implementation of `Attesto.RefreshStore`.

- Sender-constraint
  - [Attesto.DPoP](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DPoP.md): RFC 9449 - OAuth 2.0 Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP).
  - [Attesto.DPoP.ReplayCache](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.DPoP.ReplayCache.md): In-memory, TTL-bounded cache of seen DPoP proof `jti` values.
  - [Attesto.MTLS](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.MTLS.md): RFC 8705 - OAuth 2.0 Mutual-TLS Client Authentication and
Certificate-Bound Access Tokens.

- Scopes
  - [Attesto.Scope](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Scope.md): Scope grant-form matching for OAuth-style `<resource>.<action>` scopes.

- Metadata
  - [Attesto.Discovery](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Discovery.md): RFC 8414 - OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.
  - [Attesto.JWKS](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.JWKS.md): RFC 7517 - publish the signing keys' public halves as a JWK Set.

- Keys
  - [Attesto.Key](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Key.md): Pure helpers for working with signing material as PEM strings.
  - [Attesto.Keystore](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Keystore.md): The behaviour Attesto uses to obtain signing and verification keys.
  - [Attesto.Keystore.Static](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Keystore.Static.md): A simple `Attesto.Keystore` backed by application configuration.

- Shared
  - [Attesto.ClusterGuard](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.ClusterGuard.md): Refuse to start a per-node ETS store on a clustered BEAM.
  - [Attesto.Secret](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Secret.md): Generate and hash the opaque secrets that back stateful grants.
  - [Attesto.SecureCompare](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.SecureCompare.md): Constant-time comparison of two binaries.
  - [Attesto.Thumbprint](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Thumbprint.md): Canonical SHA-256 thumbprint shape, shared across the sender-constraint
schemes.

- Testing
  - [Attesto.Test.DPoP](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Test.DPoP.md): DPoP test fixtures for host application suites.
  - [Attesto.Test.DPoPVerifier](https://attesto.hexdocs.pm/Attesto.Test.DPoPVerifier.md): Server-side DPoP verification harness for host application test suites.
